# E-Housing

> > E-Housing is a Tokyo-based real estate service specializing in housing solutions for expats and foreigners living in Japan.

E-Housing provides comprehensive guides for international residents navigating Tokyo's neighborhoods, transportation systems, and daily life. The site covers everything from finding apartments in premium areas like Minato Ward and Shibuya to practical advice on moving seasons, business etiquette, and working holiday visas.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo neighborhoods
- Expat living in Japan
- Minato Ward
- Yamanote Line
- Shibuya
- Roppongi
- Toranomon
- Japanese real estate market
- Relocation guides
- Transportation in Tokyo
- Working holiday visas
- Business etiquette
- Cost of living comparisons
- Luxury apartments

## Essential Guides for Expats

- [Tokyo Train & Railway Guide: A Complete Overview of Subways, JR Lines, and Transfers](https://e-housing.jp/post/tokyo-train-and-railway-guide-japan-travel-around-tokyo): Complete Tokyo train navigation guide: JR lines, metro, Suica/Pasmo IC cards
- [Understanding Japan's Moving Season: Key Periods and Preparation Strategies](https://e-housing.jp/post/understanding-japans-moving-season): Japan moving season guide: peak periods, costs, relocation strategies
- [Working Holiday in Japan: Visa Application and Guide to Finding Jobs](https://e-housing.jp/post/working-holiday-in-japan-visa-application-and-guide-to-finding-jobs): Working holiday visa guide: application process, job finding tips for Japan
- [Guide to Japanese Business Etiquette in Japan](https://e-housing.jp/post/guide-to-japanese-business-etiquette-in-japan): Japanese business etiquette: meetings, greetings, business cards protocol
- [Tokyo Gyms Guide: Best Gyms for Foreigners in Tokyo](https://e-housing.jp/post/tokyo-gyms-guide-best-gyms-for-foreigners-in-tokyo): Foreigner-friendly Tokyo gyms: Gold's Gym, Anytime Fitness, chocoZAP guide

## Tokyo Neighborhood Guides

- [Tokyo Neighborhood Guide: Toranomon Area](https://e-housing.jp/post/toranomon-area-guide): Toranomon area guide covering Hills Tower, Roppongi proximity & expat living
- [Tokyo Neighborhood Guide: Nishiazabu, Minato](https://e-housing.jp/post/tokyo-neighborhood-guide-nishiazabu-minato): Nishiazabu, Minato Ward guide: luxury housing near Roppongi intersection
- [Tokyo Neighborhood Guide: Takanawa, Minato](https://e-housing.jp/post/tokyo-neighborhood-guide-takanawa-minato): Takanawa, Minato Ward guide: historical district with modern conveniences
- [Tokyo Neighborhood Guide: Daito, Taito](https://e-housing.jp/post/tokyo-neighborhood-guide-daito-taito): Taito Ward neighborhood guide featuring Ueno, Asakusa districts & transit
- [Tokyo Neighborhood Guide: Minami-Otsuka, Toshima](https://e-housing.jp/post/tokyo-neighborhood-guide-minami-otsuka-toshima): Minami-Otsuka guide: Toshima Ward area near JR Otsuka Yamanote Line station

## Real Estate Market Insights

- [What Japan Real Estate Will Look Like in 2026: Market Outlook, Investment Opportunities & Government Policies](https://e-housing.jp/post/what-japan-real-estate-will-look-like-in-2026-market-outlook-investment-opportunities-and-government-policies): 2026 Japan real estate outlook: Tokyo prices, investment opportunities, policy
- [Tokyo vs Osaka vs Fukuoka: Average Rent & Cost of Living Comparison](https://e-housing.jp/post/tokyo-vs-osaka-vs-fukuoka-average-rent-and-cost-of-living-comparison): Rent & cost of living comparison: Tokyo, Osaka, Fukuoka for expats
- [The Rise of Luxury Apartments in Tokyo: How to Find the Perfect Penthouse](https://e-housing.jp/post/how-to-find-the-perfect-penthouse): Tokyo luxury penthouse guide: Minato-ku, Roppongi, Akasaka premium properties
- [Exploring the Wealthiest Neighborhoods in Tokyo, A Comprehensive Guide](https://e-housing.jp/post/top-3-most-expensive-parts-of-tokyo): Tokyo's wealthiest neighborhoods: Azabu, Hiroo, Daikanyama luxury areas
